bg.title: Оценка на FinOps и разходите за AI
bg.intro: 25 въпроса в 12 области: разпределение, собственост, прогноза, ангажименти, ефективност, излишни разходи, модели, токени, кеширане, видимост, известия и одобрения. Без цени и без прогнози за спестявания.
bg.disclaimer: Самооценка по вашите отговори. Не използваме ценоразписи на доставчици, не изчисляваме спестявания и нямаме достъп до сметките ви. Не е одит, не е финансов и не е правен съвет.

en.title: FinOps & AI Cost Assessment
en.intro: 25 questions across 12 areas: allocation, ownership, forecasting, commitments, efficiency, waste, models, tokens, caching, visibility, alerts and approvals. No prices and no savings forecasts.
en.disclaimer: A self-assessment based on your answers. We use no provider price lists, calculate no savings and have no access to your billing accounts. Not an audit, not financial and not legal advice.

initial.title: Initial
initial.description: Most practices are manual or missing; risk depends on individual people.

developing.title: Developing
developing.description: Basic practices exist, but not everywhere and not consistently.

defined.title: Defined
defined.description: Practices are standardised and most are applied automatically.

optimised.title: Optimised
optimised.description: Practices are automated, measured and continuously improved.

risk_no_allocation.title: Spend without an owner
risk_no_allocation.description: Without allocation nobody sees their own spend and nobody reduces it.

risk_no_alerts.title: Surprises on the invoice
risk_no_alerts.description: Without alerts a mistake or spike shows up only on the invoice.

risk_unrestricted_models.title: Unrestricted paid model access
risk_unrestricted_models.description: Without approved uses and quotas, model spend grows uncontrolled.

risk_ai_unaccounted.title: AI spend without accounting
risk_ai_unaccounted.description: Without per-feature spend you do not know which AI feature is worth it.

risk_commitment_lockin.title: Commitments without analysis
risk_commitment_lockin.description: Reservations made without a usage analysis can go unused.

qw_tags.title: Mandatory tags
qw_tags.description: Three tags (product, team, environment), enforced by policy.

qw_budget_alerts.title: Budgets and alerts per owner
qw_budget_alerts.description: A budget per owner with alerts at 80% and 100%.

qw_idle_envs.title: Schedules for test environments
qw_idle_envs.description: Stop test environments outside working hours.

qw_model_quotas.title: Quotas for paid models
qw_model_quotas.description: Approved uses and quotas per team.

qw_feature_tags.title: A feature tag on every AI request
qw_feature_tags.description: Add the feature and customer to every request so spend can be split by them.

rec_allocation.title: Cost allocation
rec_allocation.description: Enforced tags and rules for shared costs.

rec_ownership.title: Budget owners
rec_ownership.description: Teams own their budgets and review them regularly.

rec_forecasting.title: Forecasts and variances
rec_forecasting.description: Unit-cost forecasts and automatic anomaly detection.

rec_commitments.title: Commitment decisions from analysis
rec_commitments.description: Reservations only after a usage analysis, with rules on term and size.

rec_compute.title: Efficient compute
rec_compute.description: Rightsizing to real load and autoscaling.

rec_waste.title: Finding waste
rec_waste.description: Automated policies for idle resources and environments.

rec_model_governance.title: Model rules
rec_model_governance.description: A model per task, chosen from quality and cost evaluation.

rec_token_accounting.title: AI spend accounting
rec_token_accounting.description: Spend per feature, customer and request in shared reports.

rec_caching.title: Caching and batching
rec_caching.description: Cache repeated parts and batch non-urgent work, with a measured effect.

rec_provider_visibility.title: One view of spend
rec_provider_visibility.description: A shared dashboard for cloud, AI and SaaS with daily data.

rec_alerts.title: Alerts and quotas
rec_alerts.description: Alerts per owner and on anomalies, and quotas for all resources.

rec_approvals.title: Approving optimisations
rec_approvals.description: Review the impact on quality and reliability and track the result.

ts_unit_economics.title: Unit economics
ts_unit_economics.description: Cost per customer, order or AI request, tracked alongside business metrics.

ctx_not_roi.title: This is not an ROI calculator
ctx_not_roi.description: The assessment covers cost-management practices. It uses no price lists, calculates no savings and has no access to your billing. For a business case, use the ROI calculator.
